metadata.title: The second gap for self-shrinkers with constant norm of the second fundamental form
metadata.abstract: Let $X: M^{n}\to \mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ be a complete self-shrinker with constant squared norm of the second fundamental form $S$. In this paper, we prove that if $S\leq \frac{10}{7}$, then $S=1$ or $S=0$, and the self-shrinker is isometric to either a round sphere $\mathbb{S}^n(\sqrt{n})$ with the center at the origin, or a cylinder $\mathbb{S}^k(\sqrt{k})\times \mathbb{R}^{n-k},~~1\leq k\leq n-1$, or a plane through the origin.
